chat.t: The wind carries our destiny, introducing me to a new friend.

o: I never sent anything like that.

chat.t: I was merely speaking of refinement.
My name is Dan Xi.
A guest of the Orchid Clan and a warrior of the Fairwinds Association.
From what rumors say...
I heard that you are well-versed in refinement, so I reached out.

o: I don't know much about refinement, but I'm great at having fun.

chat.t: Ah, then reaching out was well worth it.
I hear there is a wonderful place for amusement where you reside...
Would you care to introduce me to it?

o: I can't do that for nothing.

chat.t: Of course, nothing in this world is free.

o: Can you pay with your body?

chat.t: How cheeky.
But you would have to pay a very high price.
My friend, today was most enjoyable.
Come to think of it, I forgot to ask you something.
So, is the texture truly identical to tofu?

o: Why don't you feel it for yourself?

chat.t: Oh.

o: Wait, hold on. Are you actually going to do it?

chat.t: So this is how it feels.
How impatient you are.
Do not be in such a rush.
As we spend time together as friends, surely all sorts of things will happen.

lines.t: Humanitas Downtown
I made plans to meet Dan Xi right in the middle of downtown.
But Dan Xi was nowhere to be seen...
Instead, there was a bird.
Excuse me...
Whoa, you startled me!
Shh! Calm down, Sirius.
It is not yet time to eat him.
...Yet?
Fufu, what is the matter?
Are you perhaps afraid?
No way! I was just wondering if I should turn it into fried chicken.
Ah! Wait! Hold on! Put that beak away!
P-Fufu! Ahaha!
You dare say such things even in front of Sirius.
Are you remarkably bold, or simply unflappable?
I get that a lot.
More importantly, what is it you want to do?
What do I want to do? Did I not tell you?
I belong to the Orchid Clan.
Following those merchants, I have traveled through various festivals and markets...
And I have mastered every kind of amusement there is.
And so...
Life is tedious, and daily life is dreadfully dull.
Is it not only natural for one who understands refinement to wander in search of new amusement?
Well, a newbie is always more fun to mess with than a veteran.
Exactly! You are indeed as I heard.
Now, lead the way.
And guide me to a new realm of refinement!
Tofu Street
I took the expectant Dan Xi with me and headed to Tofu Street.
This is Tofu Street, a famous landmark of Humanitas.
Oh! Tofu is a common food even back in Quartet.
Grilled, fried, braised, fermented...
But precisely because it is such a common ingredient, it is difficult for it to be special once you are accustomed to it.
Will it be able to satisfy my palate?
Why don't you try it first before judging?
Hmph... You speak the truth.
There is nothing more foolish than discussing flavor without first tasting it.
Without hesitation, Dan Xi picked up a piece of tofu from the stand and put it in her mouth.
Mmm!! This clean, subtle flavor! Impressive, truly impressive!
Come, you must eat some as well!
Mmph—!
Nom, nom, munch...
It seems there are people here who are truly passionate about tofu.
This soft, pale texture of the tofu... it is certainly extraordinary.
And look at this springiness. It is as if...
Like a breast...
Yes, like a pair of bouncy breasts...
No, what are you making me say? I meant it is like...
Like a butt...
Yes, like a warm butt that yields softly when you squeeze it... Wait, no, that is not it at all!
If you close your eyes and touch it, it might feel exactly the same.
How could that possibly be true?
Well, you won't know until you check.
Haha! You are a cheeky one, aren't you?
You might end up getting burned by the hot tofu, you know?
How can you enjoy it without a little bit of risk?
...Are we still talking about tofu?
Perhaps!
Humanitas Street
This is a truly fascinating street. It is brimming with vitality.
I have traveled through countless festivals and streets, yet to think there are still places I have not been.
Are you satisfied?
More than satisfied!
What is more...
Dan Xi pressed her body close to mine.
To have found the most entertaining amusement... is this not the very essence of refinement?
I'm not a plaything, you know.
Of course, of course.
I wish to call you my friend.
A friend who brings a fresh breeze to soothe my deep boredom.
May I do so?
There's no need to ask for permission.

chat.t: A place where passion and madness envelop the entire body.
A place where winners and losers are decided.
The cold arena of a true showdown!

o: Just say you want to go to the arcade.

chat.t: Where is the refinement in stating it so plainly?
Refinement, after all, is entirely about the atmosphere.
We must proceed step by step.
Just as snow melts into water.
Just as a child grows into an adult.
Just as flowers bloom in the warm sunlight...

o: If you keep babbling about other things, I'm not playing with you.

chat.t: I want to go to the arcade!!!

o: You were much more of a scrub than I expected.

chat.t: The stick was so small, I struggled to control my strength.

o: That's very rude to the stick.

chat.t: Yet, even the great trees of the mountains were once mere seeds.
If my friend teaches me, surely I will become a master in no time?

o: Even then, you still won't beat me.

chat.t: Is that truly so?
Did I not win the last match?

o: If it weren't for the lag.

chat.t: Your excuses are pathetic.
The fact remains that you are a scrub who lost to a beginner of just one day.
? I cannot hear the words of a loser.

lines.t: DD STATION

Having arrived at DD STATION, Dan Xi looked around here and there,
her eyes sparkling with excitement.
Ho, so this is your playground?
This is where we battle with joysticks instead of swords, and controllers instead of guns.
Indeed, yet the act of settling a score remains the same.
I thoroughly enjoy fighting the strong. I wonder what mighty foes await me here?
Dan Xi stood in front of a fighting game cabinet.
It appears to be a game where one controls martial artists.
Want to give it a try?
Of course! As a warrior, I cannot simply walk past this.
Dan Xi sat down with great vigor and grabbed the joystick.
Don't get mad when you get wrecked.
Fufu, the same goes for you!
...A moment later.
Ah, wh-what?! W-Wait! That move is a foul! That is cheating!
It's not cheating~ It's right there in the move list~
B-But still, to do something so underhanded! Continuously attacking low like that!
Just jump if you don't like it.
But then you just switch to jump attacks!
Why would I just let you hit me? And who was it that told me not to hold back, again~?
U-Uuuugh!

Dan Xi frantically wiggled the joystick,
but the limitations of a beginner were plain to see.
Ah, the sweet taste of victory!
H-Hey?
Whoa, are you crying? Really? No getting all serious on me!
Hu...
P-Fufufufu!!
Ahahahahaha!!
Has the agony of defeat driven you mad?!
No, that is not it at all.
My friend, you are truly formidable. To break me so thoroughly.
Ah, I, who am revered by everyone... I, who am admired by so many notable figures...!
To think I would fall defeated before you, whose physical strength is not even a fraction of mine!
That's just because you're a total scrub.
Mmm♡! Those cold words truly pierce right through my heart.
What is this emotion?!
My entire body is... trembling...!
Orgasm-ing from defeat? You're a total pervert.
Ahh♡! But... my friend, I have never lost in my entire life.
So to speak... you are my very first.
Well, I'm honored.
Then, having taken my first, what more do you intend to demand from me?
Could you not phrase that with a bit more grace?
Would you graciously allow me to ravish your precious body?
Your phrasing may sound fancy, but the meaning is exactly the same!
Ah... to think I would entrust my fate into the hands of such a rogue...
Forgive me, children of the Fairwinds Association, and members of the Orchid Clan.
I am... to be teased and toyed with by this man's fiery lust and drive...!
I didn't ask for all that.
Only to fall into pleasure and become a body that cannot live without you...!
She keeps getting carried away all by herself.
Behold! I am ready.
Come, claim your right as the victor!!
...I get it, so just pay for the game first.

chat.t: So, what kind of amusement will you introduce to me this time?
Adults?
I have heard rumors of that place.
They say if things go wrong, you will walk out stripped completely bare...
Impossible!
The higher the stakes, the more serious one becomes.
To speak of refinement while risking everything...
Don't you agree that, too, is a splendid amusement?
There are all kinds of people at a festival, after all.
I am simply used to dealing with such people.

o: Even though we ended up getting banned.

chat.t: More importantly, if you do not mind...
I would like to invite you to the Orchid Clan's festival.
Falling petals, lanterns floating down the river, the endless chatter of merchants and guests...
In that beautiful, bustling place...
Let us enjoy refinement together.
Of course it is.
There are just as many games there as the place you introduced to me.

o: And will a scrub like you be okay there?

chat.t: Of course. That is my turf, after all.
You, my friend, had better watch out so you do not get utterly wrecked.

lines.t: Bunny Empire
So this is the Bunny Empire I've heard so much about.
You've never been here before?
Of course, since my duty is to protect festivals.
But... this does look quite interesting.
As they say, the higher the stakes, the greater the fun.
I enjoyed the Bunny Empire's games with Dan Xi.
Surprisingly, Dan Xi won consecutive victories and earned quite a lot of coins.
By the way, if we win this much...
Excuse me, customer, do you have a moment?Bunny Rookie A
Oh? And who might you be?
Your skills are quite impressive...Bunny Rookie B
How about testing your luck against us?Bunny Rookie A
It's a trap.
We are simply offering you a more enjoyable and thrilling match!Bunny Rookie A
Surely playing for pennies isn't enough for you, is it, customer?Bunny Rookie B
Or... are you going to throw away a chance to make a fortune?Bunny Rookie B
Heh, if you put it that way, how could I possibly refuse?
Are you seriously going to let them play you?
Of course not. But wouldn't it be amusing to throw ourselves into the rushing current?
Now, what game do you intend to entertain me with?
In that case...Bunny Rookie A
The "Master Dice Game"!Bunny Rookie B
Master Dice Game...!?
You roll the dice and follow the Master's commands on whatever space you land on!Bunny Rookie A
By the way, if you don't follow the Master's commands, you lose instantly!Bunny Rookie B
You also lose if you run out of funds along the way!Bunny Rookie A
Oh? That sounds quite amusing!
Sounds like a garbage RNG game to me.
But isn't that what makes it fun? Fufu...
Alright, let's begin!Bunny Rookie A
I teamed up with Dan Xi and started the game with the Bunny Rookies.
Alright! The Master's command! Player A pays compensation to Player B!Bunny Rookie B
And Player C hands over their most expensive land to Player D!Bunny Rookie A
Urgh...
My...

I joined forces with Dan Xi to play against the Bunny Rookies,
but our luck with the dice was terrible.
Oh my, looks like you're about to be completely cleaned out!Bunny Rookie AA customer with no money isn't a customer at all!
Mmm... our luck is truly terrible. We have been rolling nothing but low numbers for a while now...

While that was happening, I suddenly noticed a strange light on the floor.
That light was...
(These guys are cheating.)
(Cheating!?)
(Look at the floor.)
On the floor, a strange groove was moving.
A moving floor... that could manipulate the dice roll.
Foul play in a game that should be fair... Breaking the rules?
Ch-cheating? There's no such thing!Bunny Rookie A
That's right! We never broke any rules!Bunny Rookie B
Is there even a rule saying we can't move the floor?Bunny Rookie AKyahahaha!
Is that so? In that case...
With those words, Dan Xi walked out.
Are you giving up?Bunny Rookie A
Not a chance.
Crunch!  Crunch!  Crash!!!
W-What is that?!Bunny Rookie B
Apologies for keeping you waiting.
It was far too large to be called a die.
It was incredibly massive, incredibly heavy, and crude.
It was, quite literally...
Th-That's the Display Dice from the front entrance!?Bunny Rookie A
I-Its weight must be over a ton...Bunny Rookie B
Fufu. There was no rule saying we could not change the dice, was there?
Dan Xi looked over, as if waiting for instructions.
...Wreck them!
Now then, here I go!

On that day, a new rule was added to the Bunny Empire:
"The Display Dice may not be used."
And Dan Xi was permanently banned.
